title: Alter Table [rename column, drop column]
description:
`ALTER TABLE` has two more uses: `RENAME COLUMN` and `DROP COLUMN`. `RENAME COLUMN` renames a column like this:
```sql
ALTER TABLE table_name
    RENAME COLUMN current_name 
    TO new_name;
```
Simple, right?
`DROP COLUMN` is also simple. You just do:
```sql
ALTER TABLE table_name
    DROP COLUMN column_name;
```
## Assignment:
We realized we dont actualy need the version column. Drop the version column, and rename app_name to just app.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE deployments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, app_name TEXT NOT NULL, version TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', region TEXT);
runHarness:
INSERT INTO deployments (app, status, region) VALUES ('BWS-API', 'running', 'us-east'), ('StupidShovelware', 'Vibe-Coded', 'cn');
SELECT * FROM deployments;
expectedOutput:
id | app | status | region
1 | BWS-API | running | us-east
2 | StupidShovelware | Vibe-Coded | cn
